answer_1.quote: Given a novel context and an intended meaning, a speaker wishes to choose an existing word in the lexicon to express that meaning which the word has never been used to convey.
answer_1.outputs: Predictions of source tokens to express novel intended meanings

answer_2.quote: We assess model performance with two metrics: 1) the mean precision is the percentage of cases where a model correctly predicts the groundtruth source token as the most likely candidate, and 2) the mean reciprocal rank (MRR-100)
